slides.texte_overlay:
How To Become The Coolest
Person In The Room
Don't try to impress anyone. People can feel when you're performing. Being relaxed and genuine is what actually makes you look cool.
Introduce people to each other. "You two both love hiking, you should talk." Connecting others makes you the centre of the room without trying.
Remember small details about people. Their dog's name, the exam they had last week. Remembering shows you care, and that's rare.
Be the first to laugh at yourself. Spilled drink, wrong name, bad joke. Laughing it off shows confidence and puts everyone around you at ease.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. Always having an interesting story makes you great company anywhere.
slides.texte_sophia: Try this for 30 days: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. Always having an interesting story makes you great company anywhere.

slides.texte_overlay: Include the quiet person. Ask the one at the edge of the group a question. Making everyone feel welcome is the coolest thing you can do.
Put your phone away. Full attention in a room full of screens makes you stand out immediately. People feel it and want to be around you.
